text: I have to agree with a lot of the other players reviews. The mini games aren't worth playing anymore. They have become repetitive and boring. It seems that over the last 6 months, Scopely have become greedy. The amount of dice you use to complete these mini games is ridiculous in comparison to the prizes you receive. This season they have only had 2 gold blitz's with only 9 days left before the albums reset again. When you're gold locked it makes it impossible to finish the albums.

Up until today (6th Feb), I played the game daily and thoroughly enjoyed it. However, it appears updates have been done and now the game crashes as soon as all the initial adverts are out of the way. Unfortunately for me, a game restarting every time I open it because of an error occurring, makes it unplayable and a waste of time. Maybe I'll re-install it if issues are fixed, but for now I'll have to find alternative games, which is a shame. 2 stars because it was good.

Worst costumer service on the planet. I have had nothing but issues with the game. Game play is bugged, rewards don't show up, bank of monopoly disappeared after I spent 3 days working towards it, partner events constantly have bugs, dice have vanished from my account, game has crashed and I've lost rewards, other events have had bugs, yet every single time I have contacted customer services I get the same bs replies and they never help or resolve any issue.

5☆s just for people to see it! I have to agree with many other players. The game feels increasingly unfair and money-driven. Paying around £5 for 1,000 dice is poor value, especially when they disappear with little reward. Mini-games are repetitive. Rewards don't match the dice required. With no option to skip Monorail when that's all the game keeps giving you. The game has become less rewarding, less enjoyable, and far more focused on encouraging spending. Even with the Simpsons "theme"

I couldn't claim revards from team co-op game after it finished. it just closed the window . I spent lots of money to have more rolls in the game and this happened... edit. I don't know where in game support is. edit2. lost 400 spins due to not being able to play for last 10 minutes of daily timer. game wouldn't load and when it did,it would freeze till the time was up. I give this stupid game 0 stars. the worst I played. I'm sure page to take our money always works fine.

Used to be enjoyable, but I've noticed that it recently became harder to land on good/higher numbers. take the current partners game. I always land on lower amounts, occasionally land on grim and even then I mostly land on 25. it's like they want you to not be able to complete a game without buying more dice to get more crows to use. I've been debating not playing anymore.

This game cheats all the time. The creators are money-hungry. The prizes that require real money are unreasonable and not helpful at all as you must pay about 5 pounds for only 1,000 dice, and when you purchase them, the game simply lets you make rounds without giving you anything, just to eat all your dice. In addition, they experiment by giving different mini-games to different players with the same prize, but one event is way more difficult to finish than the other. Totally unfair.

mogo used to be an amazing game when I started back in nov. since the new sticker album has started, the proberbilities have changed. It's near impossible now to complete anything without spending money, no matter how hard you try. I don't think i will play again after completing this album, and im actually sure many more will stop playing, too.

well designed game with good UX. The progression system is engaging and keeps you wanting to play more. However, advancing becomes nearly impossible without spending significant amounts of money, specially at higher levels. Games like this should face stricter regulation, as they often rely on encouraging spending from vulnerable players. I wouldn’t recommend it and I will absolutely be using my "trial" as a cas study for pushing regulations further in this field.

Hello Monopoly GO Team, I’ve been playing Monopoly GO for over two years and used to really enjoy the game. Recently, though, it feels like the game has become much harder and less rewarding, especially for long-time players. Events and rewards now seem too difficult unless players spend a lot of money. I wanted to share my disappointment and hope you consider making the game more balanced and enjoyable again. Thank you.

This game is awesome, so many different events to try. The sticker collection is fun to collect and you can trade them as well with other players in the game which is fantastic. I've been playing this game for nearly a month now. It is well worth a try. I love you can win different dice and shields and tokens. I'm hoping to join the Tycoon club soon. Keep up the good work 👏

Customer service is awful, there's always in app purchases needed, pop ups constantly interfering with game play, my phone BURNS when game is running and it drains my battery. My game crashed when I finally completed my album and I missed all the rewards I'd been working hard for. I logged back in and the rewards had been added but I got no pop ups to celebrate closing my final set and album. I told customer service but they didn't care.

I've played this game so much over this past 2 years. The daily "missions" are a joke and luck based. There is a daily ranking system but mixes those who pay and those who don't so that is completely useless unless you pay-to-win Seriously! If you don't take this too seriously or want a game that keeps making the challenges harder so you are "forced to pay" if you want to win any tokens/shield/dice sets then download this game. I do enjoy seeing colabs and new tokens so I will keep on playing!

I really enjoy this game it’s fun, engaging, and easy to get into. Trading stickers, playing real-time tournaments, and meeting new people makes it feel very interactive and alive. It’s the kind of game you actually look forward to opening. The only issue I’ve noticed is delays with in-game purchases. Sometimes items don’t arrive immediately after payment, which can be frustrating. Especially when you wanna complete important milestone. Aside from that, everything else about the game is great.

I read reviews before installing and still do. I must admit it a cash grab if you pay. Scopely doesn't hold a gun to player's head to spend. If you're competitive and no patience you will spend, then complain. I also know that Scopely does frequent surveys to get player's opinions and ideas. Which have been used. They also give dice for taking survey. It's a active, visual, great graphic game. Like most play and social apps can be addictive. So now you decide if you want to play. I do and enjoy

Fun, good graphics, love if I happen to get disconnected from Wi-Fi and lose connection, my rewards are still there and added to my account when I'm able to log back in again! BUT, they are making it harder to complete albums, and this current album has so many gold stickers (more than any other) so I hope they give us more Gold Blitzes this season

Completely pay to play after leveling a bit. Impossible to advance or win in any event without spending money. The algorithms have gotten much worse. It changes with each event to land on mostly dead tiles. Any wheel spin feature lands on whatever the minimum is. The higher amount of dice you use per roll increases the chances of landing on dead tiles. This game used to be better, but now free to play players get nothing out of this game anymore.

it is a fun an addicting game however, you will NEVER and I mean NEVER finish an album without spending money. the game is rigged that way. which is sad. it is a very fun game. its had star wars, Harry Potter, even Hello Kitty. But they make it impossible to finish the sticker album. also they only allow 5 trades per day which is mind boggling. I don't understand the harm in allowing 5 trades every 12 hours. I promise if the player feels like they are getting more then money will be spent.

It was fun when it first came out. Now this game is all about making money. They have game events that happen every few days. Used to be able to complete them if you played a decent amount, did the daily missions and so on. Barely make it half way through the events now. only have completed one and only reason I did was I ended up buying rolls. Don't waste your time or money on this game. It was a fun game. now it's a greedy POS company that only cares about profits since they broke that record.

I have contacted support 3 times. They don't seem to care. This game is very frustrating when you are shut down so many times by the same person (13 ish hits). Then you go to try and shut them down but you cannot. It's nearly impossible to play or level up. Twice today I have been completely shut down and have no properties left. I guess I'm done with this game as I can't level up anymore.

The game starts off fun enough....you get through some levels and you are able to have a bit of fun while playing...but, like any game, this one's goal is to draw you in to spend money...and we aren't talking 2-3 dollars. We are talking HUNDREDS of dollars. Lots of mini games in the main game...now, of course you need to land on certain squares to get points and items to complete the mini-games. Just know that they change the algorithm for rolling dice on these games non stop. STAY AWAY!!!

i do enjoy this game, I just wish it was better. I've been seeing a lot of sketchy things about it on YouTube (bundle prices changing depending on the person buying it and how much they've spent), and for the 2 years I've been playing it, I have always struggled keeping up in events and have NEVER been able to finish sticker albums. i would recommend not spending your money on it, it'll make future bundles more expensive supposedly, and you still won't complete sticker sets.

I liked this game until I started leveling up really quickly by playing side games. Now it's refusing to give me rewards. I'm +200 points to get 34 million, which puts me at the next level. Reached out to support with screenshots. They gave me a basic trouble shoot text. Tried everything and still not rewards. They said they would look into it, but that doesn't help me get my past due reward or whatever the next one would be. Fun until you start doing well. Same issues 11/2024, 5/2025.

I think there's close to zero substance in this game. It works, runs decently, and has things to collect, but it doesn't feel like anything but a treadmill that wants your money every 10 minutes. The game wants you to connect with others to push progress in the hope that someone is willing to feed it cash, but it is ultimately not worthwhile to play

Rather boring game, not much to do, CONSTANT in-app purchase nags, but no ads though. Graphics look really nice though. Update: This game is 100% pay to win for all the multiplayer features and there are MANY whales in this game. Also you'll never complete any of the challenges or sticker collections until you give them money and lots of it. If it wasn't for the fact I play this with some friends I would have ditched this game a while ago.

It is a lot of fun. It's definitely pay to win though. You will have a very hard time collecting anything unless you pay money. Recently they done an update and added the tycoon tab. That's even more spending. They do give you a free spin and gift in the tycoon area so that was cool. It was cool. Then my tycoon disappeared. Some people can still go to the tycoon page and some can't. Maybe they will fix it. Waiting to see if I go up or down in stars for this review.

lots of errors and mishaps on monopolys side and very little compensation to the players, even when broke down in detail of everything. right before the end of an album too. pricing on things very dramatically, if you purchase stuff with money they keep raising the prices on future ones, like collecting shields and landing on rail road, piggy bank etc. its a good way to waste some time but unless your willing to spend $100s of dollars you wont get anywhere. esp with all the glitches and errors.

This is a fun little game. Good graphics and nice sound direction. Not too frustrating, but there are a couple things I'm not a fan of. Every time I start the game or run out of dice getting 4-5 popups asking me to buy more is excessive. The cost of dice is way too high. I did buy 1 dice pack using my play credit to support the game since I found it fun. The cost should be $1 for 100 then I'd be more likely to buy more.

This game is a joke. You need SO much money to build and then they pretty much require that you get friends in order to get that money but then these "friends" are the ones that attack and steal from you. REPEATEDLY! I just had ONE friend attack me 16 times in less than 10 minutes. How is that fair? You don't get enough spins to make enough money to rebuild or get shields. It's ridiculous. Games are supposed to be fun and this one is just inferiating.

Fun for a month and then gets annoying with excessive animations. At least you can turn off the emojis because those are terrible. I usually have limited down time to play. All the excessive animations on start up and in game play eat up 1/2 of my game play time. Wish you would do like other games and give us an option to turn them off. As a result I can only play for about a month and then have to stop and wait at least 6 months before I can play again.

I've been a player since 2023, and I realised that it's going downhill faster than ever. Prizes are lower and lower, from 25,000 dice for completing an album and 30,000 for completing it again when I first joined, down to a measly 10,000 for all completions. Keep in mind that you're doing the SAME WORK for over a 50% decrease in prizes. They changed the guaranteed new sticker in the vault from albums to a swap pack, and from 7 times I've opened it, I got nothing! How am I supposed to play this!?

I've enjoyed the game for over a year at this point and my one complaint is about the stickers, I've never been able to complete an album since I started this game, I always come close and closer to the end it's always duplicates upon duplicates...it's too rigged, because I play daily but not being able to finish an album every time is just pure disappointment. The sticker system needs to improve immensely, can't keep receiving many duplicates and never the cards we need.

It's fun, the events have variety and the auto roll feature is great when you want to play while doing other tasks. The one thing that really annoys me is getting 3-4 pop-ups every time you run out of rolls with the current offers to buy more. Wish there would be a "Don't show this again" checkbox or something, it's redundant.

I really love this game but not being able to keep our extra stars from duplicate stickers is a real drag. in other games I have played I've been able to accumulate these throughout albums. can only convert at 250 stars and I've had as much as 135 when the album ended so it feels like a lot of time for nothing. I'd love to have contacted you personally through the app to suggest this however that is not an option. I'm directed to either share on social media or through review of app.

Been playing this for a while now and it's still very much pay to win in every aspect. The biggest let down is the stickers!!!! You can only ask 4 of your friends to donate a sticker and on once a day. You need to be able to ask your entire friends list otherwise what the point in having one when you dont know who will have what you need? also if you have enough dice to roll 100 at a time you should be able to instead of being limited to 50 or less.

At first it was okay. But the longer I've been playing, the more scammy it gets. It purposely makes you lose events to draw you into spending money, after which its only a fifty fifty chance if your odds will even improve. It gets really frustrating especially when having to rely on others with certain events and you get someone who doesn't contribute at all, leaving you in the gutter. Game is less than appealing nowadays. Months later, and it's only gotten even worse.

I am getting very close to deleting this game. Not getting any new stickers for the album and every single time I open my community chest I only get 3 or less people. Challenges are becoming impossible to complete, with the last partner challenge none of mine got finished because everyone keeps landing on low numbers on the wheel and sometimes the same number multiple times in a row. Edit: the game has gotten even worse with the last few updates

This game sucks. Once again, another set off albums passed and have not completed the whole set. it's been about 6+ yrs of playing and I have never completed an album set. My family has stopped playing, and so will I. This game used to be fun, but now u barely get any items to complete any challenges. some are impossible for the average person who doesn't dish out money. They have gotten cheaper on the prizes and have focused more on money-making. I won't be spending a dime on this game.

Why do I have to clear my cache and turn off my device just to play the game if it crashes? I never had this problem on the iOS operating system just the Android operating system. The only good thing about the crash is when it crashes during shutdown, heist or opening a sticker pack it will still give you the rewards unlike other games. The star rating is for the crash of the game.

I have to agree with the other reviews, there's so many pop-ups when you open the app, the albums just aren't worth trying to complete anymore and the mini-games and events just aren't worth playing because you don't get anything from them. Update 24.06.25, I don't care what they say the shut down to bank heist ratio is not 50:50, it's way harder to get bank heist than shut down, especially if you have a mission where you need to get bank heist.

Great game other than the heavy pay to play. You can never finish sticker collections because they lock them behind paywalls. You can't win events because they put you against people who pay to win. It's just very, very unfair to anyone who just wants to play. Even if you play everyday and do everything you will never ever finish a event because they have made the good rewards so far away that you run out of time unless spending lots of money for the "chance" to win any prizes.

This game can be a lot of fun. It's addicting and fun to play with family and friends! There are some things that definitely need improvement. You run out of dice quickly, and it takes forever to get them back. The amount of dice and money you receive after completing boards should raise the higher you go. It would be nice if you could get the stickers you need more often. The community chest is pointless. The rewards aren't worth the effort. Discounts on building landmarks should be reversed.

I play every day and only really play because of family and friends who play it too. Wish there was a way to exchange stickers in your own game without the help of others. I constantly get gold cards that I don't need anymore and wish I could exchange them for golds that have the same amount of stars that I am missing. Also currently experiencing players thar are getting boosted in the racing event as soon as it started, they had 47k points in the mini game. Feels unfair without spending money.

fun game. rewards from playing don't feel like they push you to buy boosters, a very rare but much appreciated quality! i just wish i could turn off animations. 35% of my time in game is spent spam clicking to get through the animations that just keep piling on. Edit: Went from 3 to 2 stars. there is no way to keep your account when you get a new phone unless you have a FB account. so yeah.. account lost..

Im still enjoying this game. The new mini games are great, the different themes are great. Im defo looking forward to the new Harry Potter theme. There's still room for improvement in places though, more gold sticker trades would give us player a slightly better chance of actually completing an album.

About 6 months ago I would've given this 5 stars. Now all the events are way too short. You never have enough time to finish them. They constantly push out another event that you still won't finish. Sticker packs are now also impossible to finish. I'm not breaking my wallet. So it's fun to pass the time, but don't expect to make any real progress anymore unless you want to spend, spend spend.

Absolutely loved this game. however, the further I get in levels the harder it is to enjoy. I have put money into the game and even so, it feels if you don't pay or don't wait days to play you can't get very far. You get the same free gifts and rewards you would levels behind however everything is now more expensive and harder to reach so they barely help. I don't know. may need to delete Soon unless changed. ( would have been 5 stars if I rated 100levels ago)

gameplay seems to have been modified... I used to be able to finish every task, even the team tasks, get them all done, past several months, they're impossible to even get halfway through, frustrating. Game has been modified so that you can almost get a task, but to finish it, you need to buy dice, etc. spend money, didn't used to be that way,. you could get things done, you can complete tasks, you can level up, all without investing any money. now it seems to be tweaked that you cannot. not fun

Love it. Have been playing it on my tablet since its release. Now added to the Android phone. The game runs slower and will freeze when playing on the tablet. however, not sure if that's due from a storage issue or is the game lagging. Was going to remove and delete it. But! New Simpsons Theme is Great! I'll deal with the lagging..Maybe The issue will be resolved. give it a shot! 🤙

Very disappointed with how this season has started. Getting prizes has been so much harder and a lot more wanting us to pay to win. I've played for 3 years. I've never completed an album and I've also never struggled this much to get tokens and shields. I'm just disappointed and care less and less to play because I see no point unless I spend money.

Creators of this game should face criminal prosecution for falsely impersonating IT engineers. Never have I seen a more flawed app. Nothing works as it should, except the glitches. Where's the fun in playing if the game doesn't even load? It takes ages, and several stages for it to load. But then you have to exit again and re - enter, if you want all features to work properly instead of just being dead. Is that supposed to be part of its charm? Every new "update" adds new glitches.

not sure what people are talking about about not being able to level up or whatever. I'm on level 24 and haven't spent any $$ on in app purchases. I've been able to play non stop with the free items that's given. not really sure what others are talking about not being able to level or complete sticker packs. it's an alright game to play all the levels seem to be the same other than the costs of building your lands which like all other games the higher the level the more the prices are.

Can basically get no where on this game unless you pay money, then when you do, you still don't get anything. The extra little games and prizes and stickers to get more dice, you'll constantly be spending more to try and get what you need. You will always be missing one thing. Yes you can ask others, but rarely do they have it either and they have it to where the ones you need, you can't trade.

played for well over a year now, they have made it almost impossible to complete an album. They tell you that dice rolls, card packs and such are random, but it's a lie. Even purchasing things doesn't improve your odds. It's turned into a time killer instead of a fun game. It's become another money grab game. As for trading stickers for one's you don't have is also almost impossible, because you hardly ever get duplicate stickers worth value, tons of 1,2 and 3 star stickers, nothing higher.

Has the worst customer service ever. The game has been made where it's nearly impossible to retrieve old account progress and purchases back because of the impossible list of things you need in order to recover it. The only way to recover an old account is through customer service and they ended my conversation without answering any of my questions and continues to be short and unhelpful. A shame because I really liked this game but I don't see a point in redoing everything I built up.

It's still a good game, but because you guys decided to put a cap on passive rolls to 400 (which i was at around 800) it made this game not enjoyable. Like if you dont spend money on the game, its hard to get through even 1 board, and it seams your never able to get your dice count up enough for the 50 times multiplier. I feel like if you raise the cap from 400 to 800, a lot more people would stay because thats when you can hit the 50 times. I have more to say but dont have enough space!

This game is a really fun game. i don't get many ads. It's a very big time killer. You even get to play with friends! if you go on the train button and land on it, you can take away other people's buildings on their board, the person I got was my own uncle! so if you have friends, you might be able to meet them on monopoly. and there are literally not ads, I have not gotten any ads!!!!!! this game is a must have thank you. So much Monopoly Go!!!

This game started out fun, but it has become more frustrating than enjoyable. It feels like everything is designed to push players into spending money. The dice rolls often seem unfair, progress is painfully slow without purchases, and events are becoming more repetitive while offering less rewarding prizes. The constant pop-ups and limited-time offers make the game feel more like a cash grab than a fun experience. Even after spending time completing event.

The game used to be fun but now it seems nothing more than a money grab with tons of cheaters and scammers. The game constantly has annoying purchase pop ups. On top of being greedy, they allow cheaters to continue playing preventing regular players from being able to fairly progress in team games like the racing event. Three days of "competing" against a cheating team with no help from the game. They tell you better luck next time. Customer service sucks and never actually fixes the issue.

It is a rich person's game. Unless you pay to play you do not progress in the game very fast. You spend all your time trying to earn money to buy property and then once you have your hotels built the color wheel takes all your hotels off the board. This doesn't allow you to collect much from other players or continue to progress to a high class. Not fair and not even close to the actual board game.

The mechanics are easy to figure out and smooth. The graphics are great The one star is the gameplay itself. There's no way to casually play and win anything. All the events are rigged in way to never successfully finish them unless you get around their "normal" gameplay. Casual players will never finish albums/events so don't even bother downloading it. Also their offers are shady, the price (if you spend your money) is different then anothers price. Yours may say $5, same thing $2 for them.

I think this game has to be the most addictive game, it's certainly the game I've had longest on my device. I was wandering though, the Partnership event, if & when you finish your four towers (that's what I call them) would you ever consider adding something in where any tokens left over before the event ends, that you can donate them to other players instead of getting paid out at the end? I wouldn't mind doing that. Anyways, keep up the awesome work 👍🏻❤️

​⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An absolute blast and super addictive! I downloaded this just to pass the time, and now I'm hooked. The graphics are colorful, the animations are incredibly smooth, and it's a perfect casual game. Doing bank heists and shutting down my friends' landmarks is way too satisfying. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fun, fast-paced time-killer!

Love this game....though it is pretty expensive to continue playing as the levels progress. I've played for almost 2 yrs and spent enough on dice that I am embarrassed to list the amount. But this game is addictive and one of the only games where you can make "friends" with total strangers. It makes the game more engaging and the new chat app has only enhanced the game. Give it a try!

My favorite addition lol. Collecting card packs is one of my favorite features. I also love how every few months there is a new theme I started playing in the middle of the Disney theme but, have to say I absolutely love the Simpsons theme better. landing on free parking and having to roll the dice and miss the booby traps is pretty suspenseful. I can't wait to see what theme is next.

That last update rendered the game useless. It wouldn't let me play without updating and afterwards just sat there saying it's taking a bit, just wait. Closing and reopening dozens of times didn't help. There's no issue with my phone's memory or anything else. The only way to play was to uninstall then reinstall starting all over from scratch. It's pathetic.

Loved the game until the recent update. Submitted a ticket as the app keeps crashing but instead of assisting and correcting the problem I was passed around to several reps that not only have not fixed the problem they have suspended me for no reason at all twice. Yesterday I got suspended. Reached out and the lifted the suspension immediately and apologized for the error. Today it was done again so reached back out and was told I violated the terms of service but would not say which terms.

This app is connected to Free Cash an I have gotten most of my rewards later than I completed them. The amount goes down every 3 days. so instead of $25.72 I only got $13.64. Or something similar to that. It's been with every reward over $10. They say it's because of the game an the game says it's because of the app an I keep getting the around!

was fun for a while but now anytime there's a group/team event I can't participate because the app just crashed constantly. restarted my phone, cleared the app cache, even tried removing and readding the app and taking my phone off WiFi, but still constant crashes every time I try to participate. hopefully they update their servers soon. **Edit** HAHAHA right after I posted this review my account was suspended for violating the terms and services. what a joke.

This game isn't as enjoyable as it used to be. I was ready to quit, but I do love the Simpsons so I've stuck around and there HAVE been fun new side games as part of this promo. BUT still -too many albums of stickers that can't be gifted or swapped and not enough special events or opportunities to collect them.... -The team events, especially the races, go by so quickly. Racing solo isn't as fun but I hate letting my team down if I happen to be a bit more involved in life off-line on race days.

Fun to play it keeps you coming back!!! I feel like it just keeps getting bette.. this is great the simpsons.. it fun . the only thing I get a little grumpy at is always losing in the races and pinball I can't afford to spend a lot of money but I do spend a little bit. but still , always losing.. and the tycoon club the spin I know people who have landed on 5oo dice alot . I have only gotten it 2 but I hit money . and I get so close on stickers. but I am always short by at least 10. it is fun

PLEASE add a Google sign. When I get a new phone, I don't want to have to go through the whole tutorial just to get to the settings to sign in. Not everyone has Facebook!! Also why was the Tycoon link removed from the menu?!?! There's way too many pop-ups. It's absolutely absurd how many there. Get rid of the app start pop-ups at least. If people want to buy something we'll open the store. I just want to start playing as soon as I open the app. Also,

I absolutely LOVE this game, with just ONE exception. As the other "races", "games", inside this game begin, you'll notice how freely the "points" are given, or "won", needed to play those, but as time starts to run out, & your close to actually winning, suddenly you could roll 700 times, & you won't get one more point to play that game. One sticker away from fairy tale win, for 3 days, nothing. Wasted time & money, only to see it rigged, sadly, I quit.

This is a fun game, easy to play and no ads. I can play on my breaks or while watching TV. However I find it impossible to finish the mini games and collect top prizes. Even when I play most of the day while being lazy lol. It would be nice too if it was way easier to collect new shields, dice, or tokens. I will keep playing as I enjoy the mindless entertainment, but I have stopped participating in most of the mini games due to the frustration of never getting close to winning.

Great, fun, addictive game!! Unfortunately, it is yet another one of those games that are HIGHLY stacked to people who pay to play. The dice, sticker, and coin packages are INSANELY expensive. Seriously, if you can pay $70 for a package of dice for a game that you'll never get anything from, then this is the game for you!!! Gold stickers are near impossible to come by - it is pretty rare to finish an entire album, even when you become "gold-locked" (when you have every sticker except golds.

The app has crashed out twice, asking me to uninstall and reinstall it, the first time tech support fixed it promptly and I went back to the level and stats I was currently at. The 2nd time tech support said there wasn't anything they could do to help me... basically leaving me to start all over, I have been playing almost a year at this point, I'm not starting over. Very poor support

I have been playing this game for years. All of a sudden, I was suspended for 3 days for "unfair game play". I literally was playing normally when I'd get bored. No cheating or anything. I contacted customer support to see if maybe it was just a mistake and they could fix it, but nope. I have to wait it out. Makes me unsure of playing in the future if normal game play can trigger this randomly.

Wish I had never bought dice! This is the only game I play on my phone and I'm hooked! But warning if you spend money for dice, like $1 here and $3 there, it adds up to hundreds of dollars! Designed to take your money. This game isnt set for your experience, its made to take your money and as soon as you almost complete a challenge, it will change into a different challenge. This "game" is fixed. The more you need to land on a space, the less you actually will. Other players can ruin your experience as well. I was playing to rank up in the tournament and because your app glitches, I was unable to complete. Also, as players rank up, we should earn more dice. Not all of us can afford to pay for them. To be over 7000 and still only getting 8 dice an hour, and none when I hit those milestones is insulting. This game is no longer fun AT ALL.

Fun game, when it works, and when they don't set you up for failure. It's like half the time they aggressively corner you into paying for micro purchases in order to succeed. Alright if you wanna climb up faster you need to pay a lot of money , i mean , you wait 1 hour to recharge 5 rolls that can be played in 15 seconds , what's the fun ?? Fun in the beginning. Very addictive. Frustrating trying to complete challenges. I spend money in the game to avoid being scammed by strangers in the so-called trading groups. It's a game which you kill most of your time, the bad part about the game, when you reach a higher level in the game. Your reward in finishing up a board is still the same. They know you need dices to roll and make that money.. including the amount of dices you're able to gain is also low. I would give it 5 stars, but you will waste more money on this game.

I don't understand why developers make a game that seems fun at first but becomes blatantly obvious that it is a cash grab. You have events that last hours and can never be completed. Impossible to beat, pay to play, king of the microtransaction, inundated with ads. If you are just starting out, you will never be able reach the end. Too many discrepancies to mention. Spaces moved different than number that you rolled. Always the same 1 ⭐ stickers over and over. Don't like when I'm not actually playing that I am still in games, more damage happens when I'm not playing and can't do anything about it. Similar to a slot machine this game slowly depletes you of all your rolls while dangling an "almost" carrot in front of your face. Predatory - I started playing to see what the hype was about. Initially, it was a lot of fun, but then you get sucked in. I've needed 1 gold card for 3 weeks now. Fixing my review from a 5 to a 3 because 1. The amount of dice you get per hour is insane. I'm past 12,000 and still just 10 dice an hour. And 2. This game has only gone down and down. I liked when we were actually about to complete the partner events and good rewards. Good free to play game for doing house chores, just auto roll the dice and play the "shutdown" and "bank robbery" mini game when you land on the railroad house. This game was so much fun. Now it's next to impossible to get all the stickers you need to finish an album. Plus, you need a gold card in each one. Overall it's your average coin master reskin, but at least it has better graphics and is an ok time waster if you're into this type of stuff.

MAKE IT WHERE YOU CAN SEND GOLD CARDS!! There are too many duplicate cards, making it near impossible to complete your album in the alloted time w/o spending any money on the game. It started out fun, but with all the duplicates and begging you have to do for people to send cards, it's not worth the ridiculous hassle.

I have noticed a number of negative reviews criticizing the game, but I believe these are largely due to misunderstandings about the game's mechanics. The game is not based solely on random algorithms, and players can obtain stickers through various means, including trading cards with friends on Facebook or contacts on their phones. I am currently engaged in a friendly competition with my husband to see who can progress the furthest in the game. Thank you for making it free to play! Great game!

Nothing but a money grab! I've been playing this game daily for over 2 years. I've reached level 535 so far. I participate in all the team events during the game. Just edited my review to 1 star. Game is stagnant as u go beyond a certain level as they intend for players to spend money to buy the in-game content. The game play is great. However, it's so difficult to get the stickers you want even after all the in-app purchases. Very disappointed

Love this game! One of the few that is repetative, but I actually have played it for a long time. I think it could get better with the challanges that we do sometimes togther with 4 other people. I don't know if that part is rigged, but I think it might be, since I often land on the one before the gold. Other than this, it's amazing.

Not a game! This is just a slot machine, you never once make an actual decision that impacts play, you just pump digital dollars into a machine until you run out, all while the game hounds you constantly to spend hundreds of dollars. Shameful. Edit since I cannot respond to the developers comment: there are no strategic decisions or resources to manage in this game. Monopoly Solitaire is a much better choice than this slightly interactive video.

fun game if you like predatory practices. log in, it tells you about all the purchases you can make, roll all your dice & it let's you know about all the purchases you can make but it's limited, exit game & come back later well good for you if you missed the manually exited pop ups for the purchases you could make. event days/weeks 3 to 5 plus the normal pop-ups. could be up to 8 before you get to roll. run out of dice, it's like 2 to 4 . doesn't verify age, so this can apply to minors. etc

It's okay, when you don't have people bashing you, over and over repeatedly within seconds, I get its a game. But come on, and the stickers make it a little easier for those who don't get to trade. This game was great when I first started playing. Now.. It's terrible! If you want any chance at completing your card sets for the album, it is basically unobtainable. At a certain point you don't get any new stickers. What is the use to have 7 extra golden stickers if you can't trade them. WAS fun in the beginning and seems like the developers do not even care that most players are having issues and are complaining. You constantly get an ad to invite other players. I received a similar offer, but mine contained more dice rolls and some extra cash, but the cost was $100. I love playing the game. But somehow, my game got deleted. I tried logging back in, and it created a new account and started me back to the beginning of the game. All my dice, money, and time wasted. Fun At First but the number of dice you get in comparison to the money you have to pay to upgrade the landmarks is ridiculously low. Don't even think about completing a pack of the "rare" or star 4 and 5 ones, it simply will not happen unless you spend hundreds of dollars. my son and I play this and compete in side games it's alot of fun and you can play at your own ace. I like the digging treasure game the best, my son enjoys the races. you can spend money to gain things but it's absolutely your choice. you don't have to spend a dime. the lucky coin is a joke.

Update 03 March 2025 - another sticker period just ended. After more than a year of playing, it's time to uninstall and say goodbye. This game has turned into a major drag. I get it that the company needs a cash flow, but it has gotten ridiculous. It's also become a time vacuum. Thanks for the memories.

This event was horrible. Could never land on any of the items needed. Progress was not being counted. I have 5 different accounts and all were the same! I enjoy playing the game but having to wait an hour for only 8 dice is way too long. It's seems like when I first began playing we could get dice more frequently now it's almost impossible. Game is great at first. As you progress though, it becomes a heavy pay to win game. Events are decent but again, if you're expecting to win. You're going to have to pay for that win. Support tries to help, but their game developers can't fix anything. My account has been randomly frozen for over two months and they can't identify nor resolve the issue. This game is so expensive! All the packages are ridiculously priced, and the side games are so hard to complete! This game is just a cash grab and not in a fun way! Partner games are impossible to complete without dropping hundreds of dollars. Not happy!

I'll update the review when I know you guys update the game better when there are fewer hackers in the game. Money pit
